items.title: Check-up and clean
items.text: A thorough exam, a gentle polish and a plan you understand. From $85.

items.title: Teeth whitening
items.text: Up to eight shades brighter, in the chair or at home. From $320.

items.title: Clear aligners
items.text: Straighter teeth, with a 3D preview of your smile first. From $2,400.

items.title: Dental implants
items.text: Natural-looking replacements, planned on a 3D scan. From $1,900.

items.title: Children's dentistry
items.text: Friendly first visits that make the next one easy. Free on family plans.

items.title: Emergency care
items.text: Toothache or a chipped tooth, seen the same day. From $95.

items.text: Book online or call. A short form lets us know your history before you arrive.

items.title: Care that lasts
items.text: Treatment at your pace, then reminders so small things stay small.

items.q: I'm nervous about the dentist. Can you help?
items.a: Yes. Tell us when you book. We go slowly, agree a stop signal and offer sedation for longer treatments.
Most major insurers, and we submit the claim for you. No insurance? Our plans cover routine care.
You get a written, itemised price before anything starts. Payment plans start from $500.
Please do. We see children from their first tooth and keep visits short and fun.
